plain_description: DeepSeek-V3 is a state-of-the-art open-source language model that delivers performance rivaling the best closed-source models at a fraction of the training cost. It excels at reasoning, coding, math, and multilingual tasks, making it a powerful foundation for building AI applications.
technical_description: DeepSeek-V3 is a 671B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 37B activated parameters per token, using Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures. It employs an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy and a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) training objective. The model was pre-trained on 14.8 trillion tokens using an FP8 mixed precision training framework. Inference is supported via multiple community frameworks including SGLang, vLLM, LMDeploy, TensorRT-LLM, and LightLLM, with support for FP8, BF16, and INT4/8 quantization. The model supports a 128K context window and is available as both a base and chat variant.
title: DeepSeek-V3
